title: horizon-mod.toml
description: A Horizon content mod (.hmod): blocks, items, mob effects, recipes and assets from data/ and assets/, no code. Reference: docs/mods.md in Horizon. Unknown keys are refused.

id.description: The mod id and its namespace: [a-z0-9_], 1 to 64 characters.

api.description: The mod API it is made for: 0.2 for content mods.

side.description: Where it runs: both for content mods (the server tells clients which version it expects).

capabilities.description: What it may do, shown to the player before they turn it on. A content mod has registries.

namespaces.description: More namespaces the mod's files use besides its id (not minecraft, c or horizon).

experimental.description: Capabilities still experimental that the mod asks for.
